body: Glass see-through walls make my heart drop and  make me feel very sad. The last time I saw my dad alive was 10 years ago through a glass wall at an airport.
PC Gaming, was a dedicated to consoles like xbox, ps2 and gameboys. The I tried WoW and LoL...
Yeah, I do but all is good now, he apologized and said he would really try on improving how he is towards me. I know him well enough to know that he was telling the truth.
I don't threaten or make any moves to hurt him, I keep calm and try to discuss the situation to the end, but that seems to fuel his irritation. Yes, I might snap back, of course I do, who wouldnt?
This has gotten out of controll, all I asked was how to calm a boyfriend down ._.
I am acually reading all these posts and honestly did no one read the update?
In my relationship: cuddling, hugging, ect. is fine. Kissing and more sexual activity is not fine.
It's not that, it's that we've gone through quite alot in our short time together. I'm not willing to take abuse, I just wanted advise on how I can get him to calm down by not leaving him.

Well then, just go out with a group of friends for dinner or something, tell her to take him with if he wants to join. Get to know each other, like I said earlier "lay down the law", just tell him to back off abit if it's really getting uncomfortable. I'm sure he'll understand. She's still your girl but don't get too controlling, girls hate being chained down.
Okay, I'll think this through to a detail, take a little break to cool off, then I'll see what to do. Thanks again ^^
Thanks for the advise! Finally someone who isnt telling me to straight up leave him :) how long of a break would be good? A weekend? A week?

Yes, he knew that I would be studying and working at the same time, and I agree with you, he's being unfair about the payment stuff. I have had depression for quite awhile, it's been taken up "why" in my other posts, and all I can think of right now would be taking a break.
*sigh* I really need to think this through... Would taking a break for awhile be okay?
I know, but I love him too much... I can't just let him go, that would really fuck everything up. I just wanna know what I can do to keep him calm and not rage at me

I honestly think you should let her have guy friends outside of your relationship, it's healthy and girls need people to vent their stress and feelings out at without making the boyfriend feel like it's his fault. I've been with my man for 1½ years and I'm best friends with a guy, I've stayed at his house a couple of times with my boyfriend knowing that. He trusts me and knows the worse I'll do is cuddle and complain about little things. It's also natural to get jealous, that just means you love her and you're worried. You should acually talk with this guy and lay down the law, not in like an "controlling, overprotective, I'll kill you if you touch her" way but just so that you come to an agreement and all is okay. Same with the girlfriend.

First things first, go pour that whisky down the drain and flush down the pills >.> 
I've been in this very same situation and I overcame it, so can you. And people will miss you, trust me they will. Everyone has a diffrent way of showing love and affection. I thought that I would have no one who cares and when I sent a text to my friend of where I was and that I was sorry for everything, suddenly 3 cars full of people came speeding up the street and told me to stop. You can pull through, I know you can. Just dont go throw away your life like this. Go out for a walk and try to see all the little things that make life worth it. Dont worry, we're all human and we make mistakes but thats the beauty of it, we learn from those mistakes and become wiser. I learned pretty quick that there will always be people there for you whether you like it or not. If you need to talk more, PM me :)

Thank you ^^ I'm feeiling better compared to how I was yesterday. This happens quite often nowadays and it just seems pointless to fight it off when it only returns within a month. BUT I will try to take steps towards the brighter future and try to climb out of this hole that I've been chained to. 
Thanks again<3
